title: a member reports something, and the operator can take a photo down

criteria.text: A signed-in member sends a free-text report from an item or shop page
criteria.note: `ReportControl` on `ShopPublicPage` and `PagePosts`; `report.create` (#81, #82); signed-out gets a sign-in link [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReportControl.test.tsx`, `report-actions.test.ts`.

criteria.text: A report changes nothing visible to anyone, including the reported party
criteria.note: SPEC-CONFLICT. The reporter is never named to the owner (`report-privacy-db.test.ts`, seen failing both ways). But a report now hides the photo at once and the owner sees a notice (T160 #62, F078 #220 "poster is told why"); `create.test.ts` says F078 criterion 3 "amends F058 acceptance 2". F058 text was never amended [V] Checked: unmarked: `tests/report-privacy-db.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Only the operator sees or can invoke Remove; others rejected by the handler
criteria.note: `report.remove` / `report.reverse` refuse ordinary member, owner, unset operator before touching the DB; `/admin/reports` is 404 to others [V] Checked: unmarked: `review.test.ts`, `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Removal stops every surface serving the photo, writes who/when/why, listing survives
criteria.note: `report.remove` sets `photo_removed_at`, keeps URL, writes `report_decisions`; Page, share, Browse honor it. Map does not: `useMapPages.ts` reads only `photo_hidden_at`, and removal clears that column, so pins still show a removed photo [V]. Issue #577 Checked: unmarked: `review.test.ts` (decision row, never nulls URL); nothing on the map.

criteria.text: The report reaches a place a person reads
criteria.note: Always: `/admin/reports` queue, oldest hidden first. Plus SMS to the operator for urgent categories (`operator-sms.ts`, Twilio) [V]. Ordinary reports are queue-only, which meets "somewhere a person reads" [A] Checked: unmarked: `create.test.ts`, `operator-sms.test.ts`, `reports-queue-builders.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Every decision reversible from the item by a new decision; reviewer sees history
criteria.note: `report_decisions` append-only, `reverses_decision_id`, history on the card, one reversal per decision [V] Checked: unmarked: `review.test.ts` (reversal inserts, never UPDATE/DELETE), `ReportEntry.test.tsx`.
